name: mdx-pages-v1-parity-matrix
human_line: Every v1 Pages capability, accounted for: shipped, shipped differently on the governed rails, or deferred out loud with the reason.

entries.note: library + reader + editor; lifecycle derived from receipts, never a parallel status field

entries.v1: agents propose, humans approve or reject, pending triage queue with diffs
entries.note: the waiting-on-you strip + compare vs published; every decision is a receipt

entries.v1: auto_publish / light_review (24h auto-approve cron) / full_approval per page type
entries.note: ONE governed rail for every page - nothing publishes without a human decision; templates carry advisory shape instead of per-type authority; an auto-approve cron is exactly the silent mutation the doctrine forbids
history from publication receipts, restore = new publication of an old body, compare in the editor

entries.v1: create/delete relationship edges, related pages, referenced-by
entries.note: derived from recorded bodies and receipts (cites, cited-by, mentions) - never hand-declared edges that drift
authored + charter corpus, every hit says why it matched, trust chips from the same flag agents obey

entries.v1: pgvector embeddings, backfill pipeline, semantic retrieval
entries.note: arrives with CTX; candidates will filter through the agent citation policy, never around it
agents write through the same governed rail with their actor id; citability is earned per page (trusted_for_ai), not granted per agent
memory consolidation is CTX's job; pages already expose what it needs (citable list + receipts)
the lifecycle projection + the admin stewardship dashboard say what changed and what needs an eye

entries.v1: PageType enum (session_brief, signal, note, plan, article, report, decision, compliance, security)
entries.note: nine declared shapes that suggest and never block; the review rule is universal, the shape is advisory
the missing-sections advisory covers the template case; content linting waits for a consumer who asks for it

v2_surpluses: trusted_for_ai derived per page and served to agents at /pages/agent-citations.json with the receipt to cite
stewardship: owner, reviewer, review cadence, staleness that flips citability off and a fresh review that earns it back
write-once body store - a published revision is never rewritten
the World Model panel: what a page rests on, what rests on it, where the company talks about it - all derived
comments ride the Message contract and decisions surface in the World Model with zero new kernel writes
templates seed the stewardship cadence at publish, on the record
every lifecycle step is a receipt a human can open
